description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Bulumulla, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - (25/0047)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration particulars. It contains multiple declarations for different land parcels with specific cadastral information, parcel numbers, owner details, and land extent measurements, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
